description.narrative: Norad support to UNEP Medium-Term Strategy 2022-2025. Additional contribution to UNEP's ocean related work within their Medium Term Strategy 2022-2025 through the Nature Fund. The support will focus on blue economy, blue carbon, ecosystem restoration, the land-sea nexus and environmental aspects of deep seabed mining.
